title: Restore website to Version 8 state

requirements.text: Restore the frontend to its Version 8 state by reverting all changes made after Version 8. This includes removing any English text conversion changes, white-accent dark theme modifications, and any other improvements or alterations applied in versions 9 and 10. The site should look and function exactly as it did at Version 8.

quotes: Website version 8 me jaise thi vaise hi kar do version 8 ke bad jo kuch maine improve karne ko bola sab hata do

acceptanceCriteria: All post-Version 8 changes (English text conversion, white-accent dark theme, and any other improvements) are fully removed
The website appearance, content, and functionality match Version 8 exactly
No remnants of Version 9 or Version 10 changes remain in the codebase
All components render correctly without errors

constraints: Do not introduce any new features or improvements beyond restoring Version 8
Do not modify backend logic — only frontend changes are in scope
Do not alter immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Applying any improvements suggested after Version 8
